composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate before Build so a missing or blank field is a 400 naming the offending
# fields, and the body is read (and republished) exactly once here.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Reject a create that would be a second member of an existing household (same deterministic
# householdId, keyed on lastName + postcode), responding 409 — unless 'sharesHousehold' is set,
# which declares the caller intends to join the household and bypasses this block.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

# Reject creating an owner when the request's city already contains 50 or more owners,
# responding 409.
ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyCreateLimit

# Reject creating an owner once 100 or more owners have already been created today
# (by registrationDate), responding 429.
ensureDailyCreateLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyCreateLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customerCode: REGION is the region derived from the
# postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-hex chars of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone +
# lastName). A stable identity with no sequence number.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Stamp the deterministic householdId (first 12 hex of SHA-256 of normalizedLastName|postcode)
# so owners with the same lastName + postcode share it automatically. Null when no postcode.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Count existing owners (before this create) sharing the same firstName + lastName
# (case-insensitive) and record it as namesakeCount before Save.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line carrying the owner id, customerCode and registrationDate.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: warn

# Flag whether more than 80 owners were created for this owner's registration day. Runs
# after Save so the new owner is counted, matching what a later GET recomputes.
warn:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: householdSize

# Record the owner's household size (owners sharing its householdId, including itself).
# Runs after Save so the new owner is counted, driving the 'GOLD' tier (3+ members) and
# matching what a later GET recomputes.
householdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: possibleDuplicate

# Flag whether this owner soft-matches an existing owner's lastName + postcode with a
# different telephone (not a hard duplicate). Runs after Save so the same value is
# recomputed by a later GET; records possibleDuplicate and possibleDuplicateOf.
possibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it drives the derived salutation. One of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present); otherwise it is the normalized flat address. Accepted on input for backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat address when present. Normalized like address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like address and, when present, appended to addressLine1 (single space) to form the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
